name: ref-firewall-change
description: Windows Firewall rule added, modified or deleted, setting or policy changed, or active profile switched (4946/4947/4948/4950/4954/4956), summarised once per hour per machine. Measured at 413 events in 24 hours, driven by Intune re-applying 81 tenant rules; per-event alerting is not usable. The firewall service itself stopping is covered separately by the critical service drift rule.

criteria.query: SecurityEvent | where ingestion_time() > ago(1h) | where EventID in (4946, 4947, 4948, 4950, 4954, 4956) | extend Rule = extract('<Data Name="RuleName">([^<]*)', 1, EventData) | where not(EventID in (4946, 4947, 4948) and (Rule startswith "CUI Allow " or Rule startswith "LpacSense")) | summarize RulesAdded=countif(EventID==4946), RulesModified=countif(EventID==4947), RulesDeleted=countif(EventID==4948), SettingChanged=countif(EventID==4950), PolicySettingsChanged=countif(EventID==4954), ActiveProfileChanged=countif(EventID==4956), Rules=make_set(Rule, 10) by Computer | extend LocalTime = format_datetime(datetime_utc_to_local(now(),"America/Los_Angeles"),"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm") | project LocalTime, Computer, RulesAdded, RulesModified, RulesDeleted, SettingChanged, PolicySettingsChanged, ActiveProfileChanged, Rules
